body:
Both earlier check reports were atomically repaired with standing=none and canonically admitted at 00:25:43 PDT; scientific artifacts are unchanged. MAINLINE-011b stopped at intake under supersession.

MAINLINE-013 independently checked without using owner programs. All 4,554 calculated numeric comparisons (including 007/007b), 982 printed values/verdicts and 75 source-table/derived-fit checks agree. All 76 core records and 40 scaling records have source pointers and required tags; 20/21 Crossref identities were independently re-observed, one rate-limited.

No core at or below 10 kg/m3 establishes all three local checks. Best Q wrinkling-product gap remains 5,844x; the 190 kg/m3 local-model pass still has global SF 0.02035 and inferred G.

Nonblocking corrections: named S200F is 290 rather than 303 GPa, moving the ideal Q threshold 4.8175 to 5.2933 kg/m3 and required ideal fraction at 5 kg/m3 from 0.9821 to 1.0261. Basotect >9 kPa and EPS12 specification minima do not prove actual failure; preserve bounds and mark physical evidence incomplete. Qualify kd independence by fixed geometry, and correct the densest Meza specimen note. Original 17 NFI remain carried.

QUESTIONABLE estimates; projections remain PROJECTION. Five nonblocking NFI filed. CARD-013 says stop and file; no next job is named.
